references.text: Herod hears about Jesus and thinks it is John the Baptist who has risen from the dead, parallel to how Herod hears of Jesus' fame in Mark.
Herod is confused about who Jesus is, and some say John has risen from the dead, which mirrors the confusion and rumors in Mark.
Elijah is taken up to heaven, and his power rests on Elisha, which can be seen as a parallel to the idea that John's power (or spirit) could work through Jesus.
